desc:
🐾 CRITTERBLOX — Survive the wild horde!

Pick your critter partner and step into the wilds. Hordes of wild critters close in from every side!
How long can you last?

New here? A quick tutorial gets you 3 free Epic Pulls! 
👍 Like and ⭐ favorite to support the game, and join the group for codes!

⚔️ LEVEL UP every run: choose new moves, power them up, and evolve them!
🌟 EVOLVE your critter mid-run into stronger forms!
🎰 COLLECT 100+ critters from the gacha — Common to Legendary, plus rare SHINIES!
🌀 ENTER RIFTS and battle Legendary bosses for huge rewards!
🏜️ DISCOVER secret Mythical critters hidden in special events!
👥 TEAM UP in parties of up to 5 — more players, bigger hordes!
🌍 EXPLORE 10 biomes that shift as you survive: jungle, volcano, ice, ruins and more!
🏆 CLIMB the monthly leaderboards for exclusive titles and rewards!
🎁 DAILY rewards, quests, upgrades and codes!
🎉 Weekends: 2x Gold, 2x Tickets, 2x Shiny chance!

Contributors: Xirtnon, GuruIsParth, XaltedSwords
